therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: DNA crosslinking by carboplatin and microtubule stabilization by paclitaxel
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: tumor cell proliferation inhibition and apoptosis induction
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: stage III or stage IV ovarian, fallopian tube, or peritoneal cavity cancer

results.effect_size: median OS 32 months (95% CI: 22-37), median PFS 21 months (95% CI: 15-32)
results.dose_information: pre-surgery: carboplatin AUC=6 IV q21d x3, paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV q21d x3; post-surgery: carboplatin AUC=5 IP q28d x6, paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV + 60 mg/m2 IP q28d x6

context.duration: neoadjuvant 3 cycles, adjuvant 6 cycles, follow-up 5 years
